title: 实验 2-8 · 反相加法器：把直流和交流加在一起
summary: 两路输入经 47kΩ 和 10kΩ 汇到虚地：开关加上一路直流，信号发生器的正弦被整体“搬”下去；用两路输入电流算出输出。
concepts: KCL at the summing node 求和点 KCL
description: 先看「拆开看」里的 **LM358 op-amp**（左侧会自动打开）：虚短、虚断和放大器公式都在那里。
**目标**：反相加法器 Uo = −(RF/R1 × U1 + RF/R2 × U2)。用一个开关提供直流输入、信号发生器提供交流输入，看输出是两者之和（并反相）。
**电路**（±9 V 双电源，接法同实验 2-7）
| 部分 | 接法 |
| 反馈 | IN+ 接 GND；RF（10kΩ）从 IN−（求和点 SUM）接到 OUT |
| 输入 1（直流） | 拨动开关 S1：a 侧接 +9V，b 侧接 GND，com → R1（47kΩ）→ SUM |
| 输入 2（交流） | 信号发生器 FG1（黑夹子接 GND）→ R2（10kΩ）→ SUM |
| 脚 | 名字 | 属于 | 是什么 | 本实验接到 |
| 1 | OUT A | op-amp A | A 的输出 | RF 的一端（输出）；示波器看这里 |
| 2 | IN− A | op-amp A | A 的反相输入 | 求和点 SUM：R1、R2、RF 汇合 |
| 3 | IN+ A | op-amp A | A 的同相输入 | GND |
| 4 | V− | A、B 共用 | 负电源脚 | −9 V |
| 5 / 6 / 7 | IN+ B / IN− B / OUT B | op-amp B | 第二个 op-amp | 不接 |
| 8 | V+ | A、B 共用 | 正电源脚 | +9 V |
LM358 里有两个独立的 op-amp：**A**（1、2、3 脚）和 **B**（5、6、7 脚），共用电源脚 4、8。表里用的是 A；改用 B 也算对——把 1、2、3 脚换成 7、6、5 脚即可。芯片横跨凹槽：上排从左到右 1、2、3、4，下排从左到右 8、7、6、5。
**先预测**
- SUM 是虚地（0 V），两路输入电流 I1 = U1 / R1、I2 = U2 / R2 互不影响。
- 它们在 SUM 处汇合后全部流过 RF（KCL）：**Uo = −RF (I1 + I2)**。
- 例：U1 = 9 V 时 I1 = 9 / 47k，直流部分 = −10k × 9 / 47k；信号部分的增益 = −RF / R2 = −10k / 10k。再预测下面三种情况的输出。
**测量**（信号发生器 1 kHz 正弦，示波器看输出，万用表直流档量电流）
| 情况 | S1 | 信号发生器 | 测什么 |
| 1 | b（GND） | 幅度 1 V | 输出波形 |
| 2 | a（+9V） | 幅度 1 V | 输出平均值和最大值 |
| 3 | a（+9V） | 幅度 0.5 V、偏置 1 V | R1、R2 的直流电流 |
电路检查通过后，把读数填进下面的「测量」（以你自己的面包板为准）；答完后会显示计算对比。
**想一想**：这就是混音器、电平平移和数模转换器（DAC）的基本原理。因为求和点是虚地，增加一路输入不会影响其他输入——这是 op-amp 加法器比“用电阻直接把信号连在一起”好的地方。
**真实电路里**：输出范围同样是 V− 到 V+ − 1.5 V（仿真里也有），情况 3 的输出离 −9 V 还远，不会削顶。真实 LM358 的压摆率约 0.3–0.5 V/µs，仿真里没有这个限制；1 kHz、几伏的信号不受影响。
startNote: **半成品**：±9 V 双电源、LM358、IN+ 接地、反馈电阻 RF、信号发生器和示波器探头都已接好（实验 2-7 练过）。**为什么**：加法器的新东西是“几路输入汇到虚地”。**你要做**：加上两路输入：拨动开关 S1（a 侧接 +9V、b 侧接 GND）经 R1（47kΩ）到 2 脚，信号发生器经 R2（10kΩ）到 2 脚。

en.title: Experiment 2-8 · Inverting summing amplifier: add DC and AC together
en.summary: Two inputs meet at a virtual ground through 47kΩ and 10kΩ: a switch adds a DC input that shifts the whole sine down; work out the output from the two input currents.
description: Look at the **LM358 op-amp** teardown first (it opens on the left): the virtual short, no input current and the amplifier formulas are all there.
**Goal**: the inverting summing amplifier gives Uo = −(RF/R1 × U1 + RF/R2 × U2). A switch provides a DC input and the function generator an AC input; the output is their sum (inverted).
**Circuit** (±9 V dual supply, wired as in Experiment 2-7)
| Part | Wiring |
| feedback | IN+ to GND; RF (10kΩ) from IN− (the summing node SUM) to OUT |
| input 1 (DC) | slide switch S1: side a to +9V, side b to GND, com → R1 (47kΩ) → SUM |
| input 2 (AC) | function generator FG1 (black clip to GND) → R2 (10kΩ) → SUM |
**LM358 pins**
| Pin | Name | Belongs to | What it is | Connect to (this lab) |
| 1 | OUT A | op-amp A | A's output | one end of RF (the output); scope here |
| 2 | IN− A | op-amp A | A's inverting input | summing node SUM: R1, R2 and RF meet |
| 3 | IN+ A | op-amp A | A's non-inverting input | GND |
| 4 | V− | shared by A and B | negative supply pin | −9 V |
| 5 / 6 / 7 | IN+ B / IN− B / OUT B | op-amp B | the second op-amp | nothing |
| 8 | V+ | shared by A and B | positive supply pin | +9 V |

An LM358 holds two independent op-amps: **A** (pins 1, 2, 3) and **B** (pins 5, 6, 7), sharing supply pins 4 and 8. The table uses A; using B is also correct — just use pins 7, 6, 5 instead of 1, 2, 3. The chip straddles the trench: top row 1, 2, 3, 4 from left to right, bottom row 8, 7, 6, 5.
**Predict first**
- SUM is a virtual ground (0 V), so the input currents I1 = U1 / R1 and I2 = U2 / R2 don't disturb each other.
- They meet at SUM and all of it flows through RF (KCL): **Uo = −RF (I1 + I2)**.
- Example: with U1 = 9 V, I1 = 9 / 47k and the DC part is −10k × 9 / 47k; the signal gain is −RF / R2 = −10k / 10k. Then predict the output in the three cases below.
**Measure** (generator 1 kHz sine, scope on the output, multimeter DC range for currents)
| Case | S1 | Generator | Measure |
| 1 | b (GND) | amplitude 1 V | the output waveform |
| 2 | a (+9V) | amplitude 1 V | the output's average and maximum |
| 3 | a (+9V) | amplitude 0.5 V, offset 1 V | the DC currents in R1 and R2 |
Once the circuit check passes, type your readings into the Measurements below (whatever your own board shows); the worked comparison appears after you answer.

**Think about it**: this is the basic idea behind audio mixers, level shifters and digital-to-analog converters (DACs). Because the summing node is a virtual ground, adding another input doesn't affect the others; that is what makes an op-amp summer better than just tying signals together with resistors.

**In a real circuit**: the output range is again V− to V+ − 1.5 V (the simulator has this too); in case 3 the output stays far from −9 V, so nothing clips. A real LM358 slews at about 0.3–0.5 V/µs, which the simulator does not model; a few volts at 1 kHz are not affected.
en.startNote: **Half-built**: the ±9 V dual supply, LM358, grounded IN+, feedback resistor RF, function generator and scope probe are wired (as in Experiment 2-7). **Why**: what is new in a summer is several inputs meeting at the virtual ground. **Your job**: add the two inputs: slide switch S1 (side a to +9V, side b to GND) through R1 (47kΩ) to pin 2, and the generator through R2 (10kΩ) to pin 2.

measurements.ask: S1→a, amplitude 1 V: multimeter DC range, OUT to GND (the average)
measurements.explain: DC part = −10k × 9 / 47k ≈ −1.91 V; the AC part averages to 0.

measurements.ask: Same state: the output maximum on the scope
measurements.explain: −1.91 V plus the ±0.995 V sine at gain −1: top ≈ −0.92 V, bottom ≈ −2.91 V.

measurements.ask: S1→a, signal 0.5 V amplitude with 1 V offset: the current in R1 (ammeter in series with R1, DC range)
measurements.explain: SUM is a virtual ground: I1 = 9 V / 47 kΩ ≈ 0.19 mA.

measurements.ask: Same state: the current in R2 (DC range = average)
measurements.explain: Average I2 = 1 V × 0.995 / 10 kΩ ≈ 0.10 mA (the 50 Ω output resistance makes it slightly under 0.1 mA).

measurements.ask: From your two current readings, the output average Uo = −RF (I1 + I2) (RF = 10 kΩ)
measurements.explain: The two currents meet at the virtual ground and all flow through RF: Uo ≈ −10 kΩ × 0.29 mA ≈ −2.91 V = −(1.91 + 1.00). Check it with the multimeter on OUT.

hints: Dual supply: two 9 V supplies in series, the middle point is GND; V1 + → op-amp pin 8, V2 − → op-amp pin 4. IN+ to GND.
S1: side a to +9V, side b to GND, com through R1 (47kΩ) to IN−.
Generator + through R2 (10kΩ) to IN−; RF (10kΩ) between IN− and OUT.
tests: S1→b (AC only): an inverted copy of the signal, average 0 V
S1→a (DC added): same peak-to-peak, the whole waveform shifts down
S1→a with a 1 V offset on the signal: the two DC inputs add; KCL at the virtual ground: both input currents flow on through RF

tests.name: S1→b（只有交流）：输出是反相的信号，平均 0 V
S1→a（加上直流）：峰峰值不变，整条波形下移
S1→a、信号带 1 V 偏置：两路直流相加；虚地 KCL：两路输入电流全部流过 RF

compare:
**对比**：直流部分 = −10k × 9 / 47k ≈ **−1.91 V**；信号部分 = −10k / 10k × u_fg = **−u_fg**（增益 −1）。
1. 只有交流，输出 ≈ **1.99 Vpp**、平均 0 V（不是 2.00 Vpp，原因是信号发生器的 50Ω 输出电阻，见实验 2-7）；
2. 同样 1.99 Vpp，但整条波形下移到 **−0.92 V ~ −2.91 V** 之间，平均 −1.91 V；
3. 输出平均 ≈ **−2.91 V** = −(1.91 + 1.00)。R1 ≈ 0.19 mA，R2 平均 ≈ 0.10 mA，合起来 0.29 mA 全部流过 RF（从 SUM 流向 OUT）。

measurements.ask: S1→a、幅度 1 V：万用表直流档测 OUT 对 GND（平均值）
measurements.explain: 直流部分 = −10k × 9 / 47k ≈ −1.91 V；交流部分平均为 0。

measurements.ask: 同一状态：示波器上输出的最大值
S1→a、信号幅度 0.5 V 偏置 1 V：R1 的电流（电流表串进 R1，直流档）
measurements.explain: SUM 是虚地：I1 = 9 V / 47 kΩ ≈ 0.19 mA。

measurements.ask: 同一状态：R2 的电流（直流档 = 平均值）
measurements.explain: 平均 I2 = 1 V × 0.995 / 10 kΩ ≈ 0.10 mA（50 Ω 输出电阻让它略小于 0.1 mA）。

measurements.ask: 用你的两个电流读数算输出平均值 Uo = −RF (I1 + I2)（RF = 10 kΩ）
measurements.explain: 两路电流在虚地汇合后全部流过 RF：Uo ≈ −10 kΩ × 0.29 mA ≈ −2.91 V = −(1.91 + 1.00)。可以再用万用表直接测 OUT 核对。

hints: 双电源：两台 9 V 电源串联，中点为 GND；V1 + → op-amp（运算放大器） 8 脚，V2 − → op-amp 4 脚。IN+ 接 GND。
S1：a 侧接 +9V，b 侧接 GND，com 经 R1（47kΩ）接 IN−。
信号发生器 + 经 R2（10kΩ）接 IN−；RF（10kΩ）在 IN− 和 OUT 之间。
